report.summary: ARI visits KC with a clear read on a pass-first offense that leans on early-down throws. KC's run defense is solid, but its pass rush is only middling, so ARI's protection is the bigger concern. Special teams favor ARI, with KC's long field goals and kickoff coverage a real drag. Walker's status and ARI's interior losses will shape both the run game and pass protection.
